verdict.rationale: The product's own features partly support comparing sources. Audio Overviews include a "Debate" format for exploring multiple perspectives from your sources. Chat answers carry per-claim inline citations that link to the quoted passage in context, so an analyst can trace which source backs each statement. You can also restrict a question to selected sources to compare them. However, nothing documents chat or reports explicitly pointing out where sources agree or conflict, and the Debate format is audio-only. Missing for 10: an explicit agreement/disagreement or contradiction view in chat and reports, documentation of how conflicting sources are presented, and hands-on corroboration.
